### Changed

- **Bots and People** in the chat list re-check which contacts are bots each time you pick either chip, separately for each account. A chat no longer stays in the wrong category after switching profiles or after a contact turns out to be a bot.

### Fixed

- **Reply counts.** Editing a message's text or caption no longer shows up as a reply to it in the reply count or the thread panel.
- **Relays screen.** A relay's details (quota and others) no longer stack over the "Add relay" button.

### Under the hood

- Core patch #14 (reply-thread queries) now skips hidden rows. Chatmail core stays at 2.65.0; release builds compile the patched core.
